en: Oh?  Miss, what are you doing wandering about out here?
Surely you're not, l-lost, in your own manor?!
No cause for alarm, right?
If you're looking for the basement it's over this way.
Ohh, but you didn't need me to tell you that did you.  Fefefe.
For heaven's sake why are you dawdling about?
Get on with it already.
I'm in the manor!?  Was I just transported back home?
Yes, that is precisely correct.
Mikhail, what's the meaning of this?
In short, this is what I can do to assist you.
Wha..?
I have created magic gates that link the manor and the sanctuaries together.
Being able to come and go from the labyrinth as you please should ease your journey, I think.
Wow, that's quite something, Mikhail.
Huhuhu.  That isn't the only feature of the sanctuaries, either.  Have you noticed, milady?
Noticed what?
Your lives and DP have all been restored.
Oh!
Now that you mention it, I do feel... but, how?
The holy power of the sanctuary has rejuvinated your body, milady.
So I see.  Thank you, Mikhail.  This will help a ton.
You're welcome.  It was the least I could do.
It will be good to pace myself so I don't run out of steam.  You should too, Mikhail.
Oh, what's wrong?
Ah, nothing is.
For safety's sake I'll be standing by in the sanctuary. Who can say what's going to happen from here on out.
Okay.  I appreciate it.
So, what next?
Hurry back down to the labyrinth? Or perhaps rest for a bit?
